1.plot: 一位生活拮据的聋人餐饮工作者，被一名警探总督察征召，负责通过唇语解读罪犯的对话。
1.plotEn: A deaf catering worker who is struggling to make ends meet is called upon by a police detective superintendent to lip-read the conversations of criminals.

2.plot: 阿曼达是一位离异的母亲，她带着十几岁的孩子们搬到了南哈尔斯登。她面临着青少年叛逆、环境问题等现代育儿难题，而母亲的孤独又让她的生活更加混乱。本剧为喜剧《我的妈啊》中配角阿曼达的衍生剧集。
2.plotEn: Post her divorce, Amanda has had to downsize and up sticks to South Harlesden, or as the Estate Agent calls it SoHa (definitely not the area around Wormwood Scrubs prison). With both Manus and Georgie now at secondary school, Amanda has to try and get her head around raising teenagers, dealing with modern motherhood horrors like teenage drinking, fake Instagram accounts and eco anxiety. Spin off from Motherland.

3.plot: 十三岁的杰米在家中被逮捕，罪名是杀害一名同学。四集分别跟着拘捕、学校、心理评估和这个家庭的余波，每一集都是一个不中断的长镜头。
3.plotEn: Thirteen-year-old Jamie is arrested at home, accused of killing a classmate. The four episodes follow the arrest, the school, a psychological evaluation, and the aftermath for the family. Each episode is one uninterrupted shot.
3.playbill: 每集一镜到底，四集讲一个 13 岁男孩被控谋杀后的四个时刻。它关注网络厌女文化怎样影响青少年，以及父母和学校为什么没有察觉。第一次演戏的欧文·库珀在第三集与心理医生的对手戏尤其惊人。
3.playbillEn: Each episode is a single take. Four episodes cover four moments after a 13-year-old boy is charged with murder. It is about how online misogyny reaches teenagers, and why the parents and the school did not see it. Owen Cooper, acting for the first time, is especially startling in the third episode, opposite the psychologist.

4.plot: 贝尔法斯特的三名新进警察必须面对沉重的压力。面对犯罪帮派与分裂的社区，他们不知道能够信任谁，而且他们有很大的概率无法全都通过。
4.plotEn: Follows rookie police officers working in Belfast, a city in which being a frontline response cop comes with unique pressures and dangers.

5.plot: 梦想远大，没有资历，永远是她自己。妈妈被分割了，奶奶太忙了，但在一次混乱的分手后，野孩子阿尔玛打算在博尔顿自由生活。
5.plotEn: Big dreams, no qualifications and always herself. Mum’s been sectioned, Gran’s too busy, but after a messy break-up, wild child Alma aims to break free in Bolton.

6.plot: 这部迷你剧讲述了一个作家的一个夏天发生的事件，这个家庭意外地获得了一处偏远的庄园，里面住满了不寻常的居民，他必须决定如何处理这座破旧的庄园。八集中发生了令人兴奋和喜剧的事件，未来的作家 Anšlavs Eglitis 与他的兄弟 Vidvuds、父亲 Viktors 和他的妻子 Hilda Vīka 一起开始修复庄园，同时开设一所寄宿处，它成为附近地区、过去的鬼魂、来自城市的游客和 1920 年代拉脱维亚拉脱维亚知识分子的交汇点和夏季舞台。
6.plotEn: A miniseries about the events during one summer in a family of a writer who are unexpectedly granted a remote estate with all  its unusual inhabitants, and who has to decide what to do with the dilapidated estate. Exciting and comic events in eight episodes in which the future writer Anšlavs Eglītis together with his brother Vidvuds, father Viktors and his wife Hilda Vīka, begin the restoration of the estate, at the same time opening a boarding house, which becomes the intersection and summer stage of the neighbourhood, ghosts of the past, visitors from the city and Latvian intellectuals in Latvia in the 1920s.

7.plot: 百老汇，一个充满了梦想和希望的地方，有些人的名字在这里被永远篆刻在荣誉碑上，而另一些人，则只能在黑暗中品尝着梦想破碎的滋味独自饮泣。汤姆（克里斯蒂安·鲍勒 Christian Borle 饰）和茱莉亚（黛博拉·梅辛 Debra Messing 饰）决定制作一部有关玛丽莲·梦露的音乐剧，此消息一经放出，立刻就吸引了公众的目光，各路人马犹如闻到了鱼腥味的猫咪一般纷至沓来。  　　女演员凯伦（凯瑟琳·麦菲 Katharine McPhee 饰）拥有一副所有女人都羡慕的羡慕外表，却在事业上屡屡遭遇挫折，和她同样境遇的还有艾薇（梅根·希尔提 Megan Hilty 饰），两人都将能够扮演玛丽莲·梦露当成了事业和人生的突破口。随着时间的推移，制作团队逐渐扩大，台上和台下，好戏共同上演着。
7.plotEn: Celebrating the beauty and heartbreak of the Broadway theater, following a cross section of dreamers and schemers who all have one common desire - to be a "Smash."

8.plot: 讲述失去丈夫的单身母亲黛布跟她两个女儿乔西与比莉试图把生活重新拼凑起来的故事。
8.plotEn: Sisters Josie and Billie and their single mother Deb navigate life armed with nothing but poor judgement and self-esteem exclusively tied to people who couldn't care less about them. They're vain, selfish, heavily in debt, pathologically desperate for affection and bursting with misplaced, terrifying love.

9.plot: 这部纪录片系列提供了前所未有的机会了解洛杉矶县消防局的内部运作，记录真实的电话和真实的戏剧，同时向那些以服务的名义冒着生命危险的热情消防员们展示他们的面孔。这些现实生活中的英雄和他们引人入胜的故事与他们在生死前线面临的不可预测的危险一起被讲述。
9.plotEn: This docuseries offers unprecedented access to the inner workings of the Los Angeles County Fire Department, documenting real calls and real drama while giving faces to the passionate firefighters who risk their lives in the name of service. These real-life heroes and their compelling stories are told alongside the unpredictable dangers they face on the front lines of life and death.

10.plot: 关系密切的加维姐妹们一直以来互相关照。当她们其中一位的老公突然死亡，他的人寿保险公司为了证明恶意杀人动机的存在而展开了调查，并将怀疑目标锁定一众姐妹，因为她们都有充足理由杀死他。
10.plotEn: The tight-knit Garvey sisters have always looked out for one another. But when the toxic brother-in-law they all wanted dead actually dies, it turns their lives upside down and tests their bond like nothing before.

11.plot:
《花样年华》（繁体中文：花样年华；简体中文：花样年华；字面意思是“花样年华”、“花样年华”）是一部由王家卫编剧、导演和制作的 2000 年浪漫剧情片。该片由香港和法国联合制作，讲述了 1962 年一对男女（张曼玉饰）发现自己的配偶有外遇的故事。当他们在一起度过一段时间时，他们逐渐对彼此产生了感情。这是非正式三部曲中的第二部，前作是《狂野岁月》（1990 年），之后是《2046》（2004 年）。 
该片在第53届戛纳电影节正式竞赛单元首映，获得好评。梁振英荣获最佳男主角奖，成为首位获此殊荣的香港演员。 《花样年华》被选为第 73 届奥斯卡金像奖最佳国际故事片香港角逐，但并未获得提名。它经常被列为有史以来最伟大的电影之一，也是亚洲电影的主要作品之一。
11.plotEn:
In the Mood for Love (traditional Chinese: 花樣年華; simplified Chinese: 花样年华; lit. 'Flower-like Years', 'the prime of one's youth') is a 2000 romantic drama film written, directed, and produced by Wong Kar-wai. An international co-production between Hong Kong and France, the film follows a man (Tony Leung) and a woman (Maggie Cheung) in 1962 who discover that their spouses are having an affair. As they spend time together, they gradually develop feelings for one another. It is the second installment in an informal trilogy, preceded by Days of Being Wild (1990) and followed by 2046 (2004). 
The film premiered in the official competition at the 53rd Cannes Film Festival, where it received acclaim. Leung won the Best Actor award, becoming the first Hong Kong actor to receive the honour. In the Mood for Love was selected as Hong Kong's submission for Best International Feature Film at the 73rd Academy Awards, though it was not nominated. It is often listed as one of the greatest films of all time and one of the major works of Asian cinema.

12.plot: 与真人秀漫画不同，这是真正的纪录片制作，让观众体验到四对夫妇每周接受治疗的真实而发自内心的体验。世界一流的治疗师奥娜·古拉尼克博士巧妙地引导夫妻们穿过彼此和自己诚实对抗的雷区，揭示了现实生活中的挣扎——以及非凡的突破——通常隐藏在紧闭的门后面。
12.plotEn: Far from reality-show caricatures, this is true documentary filmmaking that brings viewers into the authentic and visceral experience of weekly therapy with four couples. World-class therapist Dr. Orna Guralnik deftly guides the couples through the minefield of honest confrontation with each other and with themselves, revealing the real-life struggles — and extraordinary breakthroughs — typically hidden behind closed doors.

13.plot: 一部聚焦英国监狱生活的犯罪剧情剧，讲述囚犯与狱警在罪责、暴力和艰难抉择中挣扎求生的故事。
13.plotEn: Guilt, violence and impossible choices – what does it take to survive?

14.plot: 19世纪末。在工业革命的进行中逐步扩大势力，极尽荣华的英国。但技术的进步与发展的另一面，却是自古以来根深蒂固的阶级制度导致人口不满3%的贵族支配着国家。贵族们享受着仿佛理所当然的特权，而最底层的人民连明天的生活都没有着落。人们在被与生俱来的阶级束缚之下生存着。威廉·詹姆斯·莫里亚蒂，为了打破这腐败的阶级制度，建立理想中的国度而开始行动。把夏洛克·福尔摩斯都玩弄于股掌之间的“犯罪卿”莫里亚蒂。由犯罪带来的革命，将改变世界。
14.plotEn: In the late 19th century, the British Empire nobility reigns while its working class suffers at their hands. Sympathetic to their plight, William James Moriarty wants to topple it all. Frustrated by the systemic inequity, Moriarty strategizes to fix the entire nation. Not even consulting detective Sherlock Holmes can stand in his way. It’s time for crime to revolutionize the world!

15.plot: 作家阿拉贝拉在一个晚上被下药、侵害，之后她要靠碎片把那晚重新拼起来。朋友、约会和创作都不再能用原来的说法解释。
15.plotEn: The writer Arabella is drugged and assaulted one night, and afterward has to put that night back together from fragments. Friends, dates, and the work can no longer be explained in the old way.
15.playbill: 米凯拉·科尔根据自己被性侵的经历创作，她编剧、主演，也参与导演。题材沉重，但剧本不按受害者模板写：有幽默，有复杂的友情，也有模糊的道德问题。共 12 集，后劲很大，科尔凭此拿下艾美编剧奖。
15.playbillEn: Michaela Coel made it from her own sexual assault. She wrote it, stars in it, and directed some of it. The subject is heavy, and the script does not follow a victim template: there is humor, a complicated friendship, and moral questions that stay unclear. Twelve episodes. It stays with you. Coel won the Emmy for writing.

16.plot: 改编自查尔斯·福斯曼的同名漫画小说。 自认是精神变态的詹姆斯遇上叛逆少女艾莉莎，两人踏上寻找新生活的公路之旅。随着旅程失控，他们逐渐陷入无法摆脱的麻烦。
16.plotEn: James is 17 and is pretty sure he is a psychopath. Alyssa, also 17, is the cool and moody new girl at school. The pair make a connection and she persuades him to embark on a darkly comedic road trip in search of her real father.

17.plot: 乔什·盖茨踏上了一段令人惊叹的旅程，前往地球上最有传奇色彩的地方。
17.plotEn: Josh Gates goes on an awe-inspiring journey to the most storied places on the planet.

18.plot: 1986 年，切尔诺贝利核电站爆炸。科学家列加索夫、官员谢尔比纳和核物理学家霍缪克要在谎言已经发出去之后，把还没做完的灾难拦住。
18.plotEn: In 1986 the Chernobyl nuclear plant explodes. The scientist Legasov, the official Shcherbina, and the nuclear physicist Khomyuk have to stop a disaster that is not finished, after the lie has already gone out.
18.playbill: 五集迷你剧还原 1986 年核事故，从爆炸当夜一直讲到事后审判。最可怕的不是辐射画面，而是官僚系统怎样掩盖真相。氛围压抑，细节考究，豆瓣评分在 9 分以上。
18.playbillEn: A five-episode miniseries of the 1986 nuclear accident, from the night of the explosion through the hearings afterward. What is most frightening is not the images of radiation. It is how the bureaucracy covered up what had happened. The atmosphere is oppressive, the detail is careful, and the Douban score sits above 9.

19.plot: Eve是个烦人的、聪明的、拿蓝领工资的英国军情五处特工，过去一直干文书工作，但这无法满足她的间谍梦。Villanelle是个高贵优雅、富有天赋的杀手，对暴力和暴力所能带来的奢华生活非常痴迷。两个女人都聪明绝顶，都对彼此充满好奇。在这场猫鼠游戏中，她们都想领先对手一步。
19.plotEn: A security consultant hunts for a ruthless assassin. Equally obsessed with each other, they go head to head in an epic game of cat-and-mouse.

20.plot: 莎莉是一位即将升职的营销人员，十年来，她和大卫一起过着舒适而平淡的郊区生活。但在他向她求婚的那天晚上，莎莉经历了一场危机，并开始了与艾玛的疯狂恋情，艾玛是一位迷人、魅力十足、波西米亚风格的女演员、歌手、音乐家、诗人和作家。在莎莉意识到之前，艾玛已经搬进来，重新布置了家具和她的生活。这真的是莎莉想要的吗，还是她搞错了？
20.plotEn: Sally is a soon-to-be promoted marketer who, for ten years, has lived a comfortable and dull suburban life with David. But on the night he asks her to marry him, Sally undergoes a crisis and embarks on a wild affair with Emma, a seductive, charismatic, boho actress, singer, musician, poet and author. Before Sally knows it, Emma has moved in, rearranged the furniture and her life. Is this really what Sally wants, or has she made a mistake?

21.plot: 改编自爱德华·圣·奥宾的同名自传小说。出身优渥却深受童年创伤影响的帕特里克·梅尔罗斯，在父亲去世后试图摆脱家庭留下的阴影，与毒瘾和酗酒抗争，并重新审视自己与家人的关系。
21.plotEn: A critical and often humorous look at the upper class, tracking the protagonist's harrowing odyssey from a deeply traumatic childhood through adult substance abuse and, ultimately, toward recovery.

22.plot: 一战结束后，汤米·谢尔比带着伯明翰的家族帮派从赛马和街头生意往上走，一路碰到爱尔兰共和军、政客和法西斯。剃刀帮要变成一门正当的权力。
22.plotEn: After the First World War, Tommy Shelby takes his family gang in Birmingham up from horse races and street business, and along the way meets the IRA, politicians, and fascists. The razor gang is trying to become a legitimate power.
22.playbill: 一战后的伯明翰，谢尔比家族从街头帮派一路打进政坛。慢镜头、摇滚配乐和大衣加报童帽的造型都非常有型。基里安·墨菲演的汤米冷静、带着战争创伤，前三季最好看。
22.playbillEn: Birmingham after the First World War. The Shelby family fights its way from a street gang into politics. The slow motion, the rock score, and the overcoats and flat caps are all very styled. Cillian Murphy’s Tommy is calm and carrying the war. The first three seasons are the best.

23.plot: 普通的男生朽木智弘在遊戲世界中遭到石像鬼襲擊。公主騎士愛麗絲和女戰士弗雷勇敢地戰鬥。舞者和召喚者Lolo，他熟悉的Lumines和巫師姐妹Rachel＆Katya設法解雇了石像鬼...智弘之所以在這個幻想世界Unifolia中，是因為愛麗絲和弗雷召喚了他。他需要精液來極大地增強自己的魔力，以抵抗正在爆發並接近皇家首都的石像鬼蜂群。在這個世界上，即使一次發生性關係，也必須結婚，所以愛麗絲和弗雷與智弘進行了結婚儀式，並為新婚夫婦的第一晚簽了合同...！
23.plotEn: A high school senior gets transported to an alternate reality where he has to save the world using his semen. Female guardians of this realm need nourishment to vanquish the evil that lurks beneath. And there's only one man who can provide them with what they need.

24.plot: 根据真实事件改编，讲述英国小镇Rochdale多名未成年少女被一群男子囚禁、强奸、轮奸、被当做妓女贩卖，由于嫌犯多为巴基斯坦裔，当地政府可能害怕被视作种族歧视，而未能充分调查这些案件，最终酝酿成一起轰动全国的大丑闻...
24.plotEn: The story of three of the children who were victims in the 2012 grooming and sex trafficking case in Rochdale, for which nine men were convicted and sentenced. The drama explores how these girls were groomed, how they were ignored by the authorities directly responsible for protecting them, and how they eventually made themselves heard.

25.plot: 约克郡警官凯瑟琳·考伍德管着一片并不幸福的谷地。害死女儿的汤米·李·罗伊斯出狱在即，而她正在抚养的外孙，是那段暴力留下的孩子。
25.plotEn: Catherine Cawood, a police officer in Yorkshire, is responsible for a valley that is not happy. Tommy Lee Royce, who caused her daughter’s death, is about to get out of prison. The grandson she is raising is the child that violence left behind.
25.playbill: 约克郡女警凯瑟琳查一宗绑架案时，发现嫌疑人正是当年侵犯她女儿、导致女儿自杀的那个男人。犯罪线很紧，人物关系也很痛。莎拉·兰开夏演的中年女警强硬、疲惫又有幽默感。三季共 18 集。
25.playbillEn: While investigating a kidnapping, the Yorkshire officer Catherine finds that the suspect is the man who assaulted her daughter and led to her daughter’s suicide. The crime plot is tight, and the relationships hurt. Sarah Lancashire’s middle-aged officer is hard, tired, and funny. Three seasons, eighteen episodes.

26.plot: 罗建军在儿子百日的时候进了监狱，老婆也跑了，老母亲带着孙子十六年，建军出狱时，孩子大了，他也老了，幸运的是在四十大几竟然遇到了一个与自己情投意合的女人江欣，他们彼此都认为对方是能让自己后半辈子幸福的人。顶着双方家人的反对，勇敢又满怀信心地组成了一个新家庭。然而，江欣被查出到了癌症末期，罗建军毅然要结婚；从他俩拿结婚证的那一天起，这个家庭就不太平：江欣的儿子高迈不喜欢这个继父，为拆散这个新家不断惹事生非；婚后，高迈间接害得罗建军的儿子进了少管所，罗建军的老母对高迈深恶痛绝、誓不两立。江欣去世后，出于一个男人对责任和承诺的坚守，罗建军承担起视他为仇敌的继子的抚养责任，其间有过灰心、失望，有过放弃动摇，最终以他的大爱融化了高迈内心的坚冰。这对半路父子建立起真正的父子之情 。
26.plotEn: After his release from prison, Luo Jianjun marries terminally ill Jiang Xin and struggles to win over her hostile son, ultimately forging a true father-son bond through perseverance and love.

27.plot: Channel 4预定四集性丑闻剧集《国家淫才》（National Treasure）。该剧虚构一个国宝级人才，因为性侵而被指控。该剧以调查案件以及开庭审判为主线，探讨加害人与受害人的心理。该剧由Jack Thorne创作，定于明年播出。新闻稿指，该剧取材于真人真事。讲述Paul Finchley曾主演现象级喜剧，广受观众喜爱，尽管淡出荧屏很多年，依然会被群众认出，是一个演艺界的国宝人才。但是，突然被揭发自上世纪70年代开始性侵女性。除了Paul受到铺天盖地媒体报道以及警方深入调查而困扰，还有出庭指控现已50岁的受害者也受到了同样待遇。
27.plotEn: Paul Finchley is a bona fide "national treasure", one half of a popular, long-running comedy double act. The famous comedian's world is thrown into chaos when he is accused of historic sexual abuse.

28.plot: 根据两届布克奖得主希拉里·曼特尔（Hilary Mantel）的热销历史小说《狼厅》Wolf Hall和《提堂》Bring Up the Bodies改编，讲述了亨利八世统治下的都铎王朝宫廷权力斗争的故事。
28.plotEn: England in the 1520s is a heartbeat from disaster. If the King dies without a male heir, the country could be destroyed by civil war. Henry VIII wants to annul his marriage of twenty years and marry Anne Boleyn. The Pope and most of Europe oppose him. Into this impasse steps Thomas Cromwell: a wholly original man, a charmer, and a bully, both idealist and opportunist, astute in reading people, and implacable in his ambition. But Henry is volatile: one day tender, one day murderous. Cromwell helps him break the opposition, but what will be the price of his triumph?

29.plot:
《彼得·凯的汽车共享》是一部英国情景喜剧，围绕超市助理经理约翰·雷德蒙德（彼得·凯饰）和促销代表凯莉·基特森（西安·吉布森饰）以及他们参与公司汽车共享计划的故事展开。 
第一季是在大曼彻斯特及其周边地区拍摄的：尤其是彼得·凯的家乡博尔顿；以及曼彻斯特、特拉福德和索尔福德。 
2015 年 12 月，Kay 确认已经委托制作第二部，也就是最后一部。该剧于 2017 年 4 月 11 日开始播出。第二季的拍摄地点包括：布莱尔·德拉蒙德野生动物园、伯里、伯恩利、尼尔森、威勒尔和绍斯波特。彼得·凯的《汽车共享》荣获 2016 年、2018 年和 2019 年国家电视奖最佳喜剧奖，以及 2016 年英国电影和电视艺术学院电视奖最佳男喜剧表演奖和最佳喜剧剧本奖。
该剧于 2018 年 5 月完结，两集特别节目分别于 5 月 7 日和 28 日播出。其中第一个是“Peter Kay 的无脚本汽车共享”，部分是即兴创作的，但包含了准备好的广播材料和视觉笑话。
该节目于 2020 年 4 月在 COVID-19 大流行期间回归，推出音频特别节目。
29.plotEn:
Peter Kay's Car Share is a British sitcom set around supermarket assistant manager John Redmond (Peter Kay) and promotions rep Kayleigh Kitson (Sian Gibson), and their participation in a company car-sharing scheme. 
The first series was filmed in and around Greater Manchester: notably Peter Kay's native Bolton; and Manchester, Trafford and Salford. 
In December 2015, Kay confirmed a second and supposedly final series had been commissioned. It began airing on 11 April 2017. Filming locations for the second series included: Blair Drummond Safari Park, Bury, Burnley, Nelson, Wirral and Southport. Peter Kay's Car Share won Best Comedy at the 2016, 2018 and 2019 National Television Awards, and the BAFTA TV Awards for Best Male Comedy Performance and Best Scripted Comedy at the 2016 BAFTA TV Awards.
The series came to an end in May 2018 when two special episodes broadcast on 7 and 28 May. The first of these, "Peter Kay's Car Share Unscripted", was partially improvised but incorporated prepared radio material and visual gags.
The programme returned for an audio special in April 2020, amid the COVID-19 pandemic.

30.plot: 肖恩、哈维、小玩意、崔夫和凯莉开始了狂欢和狂喜的夜生活。Woody和Lol很开心，和他们的孩子住在一起，Combo还在监狱里。但情况正在慢慢改变。这是1990年，这是英格兰。
30.plotEn: Shaun, Harvey, Gadget, Trev and Kelly hit up the nightlife of raves and ecstasy. Woody and Lol are happy, living together with their kids and Combo is still in prison. But things slowly change. This is the year 1990 and This is England.

32.plot: 当你将一位超级滑雪明星和一位科学天才放在一个屋檐下时会发生什么？你马上就会知道了！当马克斯·阿舍搬到一个白雪皑皑的滑雪小镇与阿尔文·“粉碎”·阿克曼及其家人住在一起时，一段不太可能的友谊形成了。麦克斯喜欢去滑雪，施莱德则喜欢读书。尽管这两个家伙完全不同，但他们总是互相支持。没有什么问题是这对不太可能的搭档解决不了的。
32.plotEn: What happens when you put a superstar snowboarder and a scientific genius under one roof? You're about to find out! When Max Asher moves to a snowy ski-town to live with Alvin "Shred" Ackerman and his family, an unlikely friendship forms. Max loves to hit the slopes and Shred loves to hit the books. But even though these two dudes are totally different, they've always got each others' backs. There's no problem this unlikely duo can't handle.

33.plot: 根据真实事件改编。65岁的大学退休教师Christopher Jefferies原本过着平静的退休生活，每天早上九点到同一家面包店买面包。Christopher是两栋公寓的房主，将公寓租给了两对年轻情侣。直到十二月的一个寒冷雪夜，其中一个女租客Joanna Yeates失踪，几天后她的尸体在公寓附近的草丛中被发现，这出悲剧旋即成为新闻关注的焦点，Joanna的房东，也就是留着过时而古怪的长白头发的Christopher立即被警方指控为谋杀嫌疑犯而关入监狱，新闻媒体更是大肆炒作，早已将Christopher定为真凶。而冤屈终有昭雪那一天……
33.plotEn: Christopher Jefferies's life is turned inside out when one of his tenants disappears without a trace just before Christmas.

34.plot: 英格兰西南部的多塞特郡一个安宁的海滨小镇，警察来到这个原本安宁的小镇调查一个年仅11岁的男孩丹尼神秘死亡的悲剧，之后又经历了对凶手的审判、旧案重提，以及丹尼谋杀案三年后的小镇发生的案件，每个人的生活都发生了翻天覆地的变化……
34.plotEn: The murder of a young boy in a small coastal town brings a media frenzy, which threatens to tear the community apart.

35.plot: 故事讲述了一对二十几岁的情侣，史蒂夫和贝基的慵懒日常生活。
35.plotEn: An acutely observed, forensically honest, warts-and-all look at a working-class couple in their mid-20s.

36.plot: 人类与食脑僵尸爆发战争并取得胜利后，科学家控制了僵尸，并将患有“部分死亡综合征”的他们重新送回社区，开启一场关于生者与亡者共存的故事。
36.plotEn: Thousands of dead people have risen from their graves and nearly destroyed Britain. A cure has been found - but can the treated zombies be rehabilitated back into living society?

37.plot: 当一名士兵报告遭到袭击时，她被迫在自己所爱和正确之间做出选择。
37.plotEn: When a soldier reports an assault, she is forced to choose between what she loves and what's right.

38.plot: 这是一部模拟纪录片，讲述了2012年奥运会这场世界上规模最大的演出团队在个人和职业方面面临的挑战。从a到B，从一车不讲英语的巴西人，到任命谁来举办文化奥运会，以及当备受吹嘘的风力涡轮机因为无风而无法转动时该怎么办，这一切都取决于男男女女们一天的工作，他们的工作是举办世界上最伟大的体育赛事。
38.plotEn: A mock-documentary following the challenges - both personal and professional - faced by the team responsible for delivering the biggest show on Earth: the 2012 Olympics. From getting a busload of non-English speaking Brazilians from A to B, who to appoint to run the Cultural Olympiad and what to do when the much-vaunted wind turbines won't turn because there's no wind, it's all in a day's work for the men and women whose job it is to stage the greatest sporting event in the world.

39.plot:
故事发生在二十世纪的英国，刚刚结束的战争让英国人民们看到了重新过上美好生活的希望，对于乔伊（马修·麦克诺提 Matthew McNulty 饰）来说，动荡的时局个千变万化的格局让他得以获得向上流社会攀爬的机会，凭借着战争时代在战俘营里获得的会计资格证，乔伊来到了财务局，成为了那里的高级审计职员。

　　然而，野心勃勃的乔伊对自己的现状并不感到满足，他觉得，自己值得更好的生活。一次偶然中，乔伊遇见了名为苏珊（珍娜·科尔曼 Jenna Coleman 饰）的女子。苏珊是镇上首富家的千金小姐，已经有了一个和她门当户对的男友杰克（提奥·詹姆斯 Theo James 饰），然而，杰克的存在对于乔伊来说却并不是什么难题，他有的是办法捕获苏珊纯洁的心灵。
39.plotEn: Joe leaves working-class, industrial Dufton behind him and takes a job as senior audit clerk at the town hall in affluent Warley. He takes lodgings at the poshest part of the town and starts to make his mark on local society.

40.plot: 新剧《灵界》（The Fades）被制片人描述为「相当长一段时期内人们在电视上见过的最吓人的电视剧集」。该剧描述一个17岁少年能够看见死者的精灵，一种被称为「逝者」的东西。这种东西不是鬼魂，不是吸血鬼和狼人，也不是民间传说中任何一种怪物，而是一种全新的东西。活人见不到他们，听不到他们，闻不到他们，也感觉不到他们的存在。但是如今生与死的界限开始模糊，「逝者」突破束缚进入了活人的世界。一个叫Paul的少年能够用肉眼看到「逝者」，他和他的朋友Mac将承担起驱除邪灵、保护人类的重任。一开始，Paul总是被「世界末日」的噩梦惊醒，他的心理医生对此无能为力。后来Paul亲眼见到自己身边被「逝者」环绕，才明白发生了什么事。与此同时，女主角Sarah能够预见未来，并因此遭到「逝者」的袭击。当Sarah神秘消失后，她的前夫Mark开始四处寻找她。
40.plotEn: Seventeen-year old Paul can see the spirits of the dead. When one of these restless spirits crosses back into the living world, he is forced into a fight to prevent the apocalypse.

41.plot: 爱尔兰都柏林的布朗夫人阿格尼丝是一位爱管闲事的母亲，总忍不住插手六个孩子及身边亲友的生活，在热闹混乱中闹出连串笑料。
41.plotEn: Mrs. Brown's Boys is a British-Irish award winning sitcom created by and starring writer and performer Brendan O'Carroll. The show is based on O'Carroll's stage plays about the character Agnes Browne, which were developed from books and straight-to-DVD films. The sitcom continues the stories of Agnes, now with the shortened surname "Brown", and her family who are played by real life close friends and family of O'Carroll's. After being slated by critics, the show has become a ratings success in both Ireland, where it is set, and the United Kingdom, where it is recorded. On 29 December 2012 the show began its third series. Mrs Brown's Boys is a co-production among BBC Scotland, BocPix and RTÉ.

42.plot: 《洛尔》以1988年圣诞节为背景，讲述了两年半前发生的灾难性事件。在伍迪离开帮派后，她和伍迪都发现自己很难应付没有对方的生活。Lol背负着她的罪恶感，而Woody正试图与新女友建立家庭生活，并在工作中获得晋升。肖恩已经开始上戏剧学院，尽管他仍然和斯内特有关系，但他已经和一个在他圣诞剧中表演的女孩亲近了。
42.plotEn: Set during Christmas 1988, Lol is haunted by the devastating events that took place two and a half years before. She and Woody both find themselves struggling to cope with their lives without each other after he leaves the gang. Lol is carrying the burden of her guilt, whilst Woody is trying to build a domestic life with a new girlfriend and a potential promotion at work. Shaun has started drama college and, although still in a relationship with Smell, he has grown close to a girl performing in his Christmas play.

43.plot: 改编自阿瑟·柯南·道尔创作的侦探小说《福尔摩斯探案集》。在21世纪的伦敦，退伍军医约翰·华生与天才侦探夏洛克·福尔摩斯相遇并成为搭档，两人凭借各自的能力联手破解一系列离奇案件。
43.plotEn: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st century London.

44.plot: 这部情景喜剧讲述的是一位前农村教区牧师试图应对经营市中心教堂的各种需求。
44.plotEn: Sitcom about a former rural parish vicar trying to cope with the varied demands of running an inner-city church.

45.plot:
本片改编自William Boyd的同名小说。由WB本人亲自改编成一个时长达6个小时4集影视剧本，这部全明星阵容的剧集将由Channel 4电视台制作播出。

　　主人公Logan Mountstuart的一生就像一段变幻莫测的旅程，在这段贯穿了大半个20世纪的人生旅途中，作为作家，情人，艺术品商人，甚至间谍，他的角色不断变换，又机缘巧合地与那些重大的历史事件和知名的历史人物有着千丝万缕的联系。

　　《赤子之心》的主人公是一个名叫Logan Mountstuart的英国作家。他的漫长生命开始于1906年。他从上高中的时候开始记日记。这些日记反映了他在牛津上大学的生活，以及他早期在文学上的奋斗经历，反映了他变化无常的婚姻生活和恋爱经历。他是一个贪图生活享乐的人，吃吃喝喝，四处旅行，撒谎不打稿子。然而他的生活却和一些历史性的画面联系在了一起：1926年的英国总罢工，1937年的西班牙内战。一些文学艺术界的名人也在蒙斯图尔特的日记中活龙活现的出现了，不过都带有漫画色彩，大画家毕加索表现得好像是一个左翼空谈家，文坛女杰弗吉尼亚·吴尔夫则成了一个在鸡尾酒会上举止恶毒粗鲁的人，蒙斯图尔特甚至和大作家伊夫林·沃短暂调情。在第二次世界大战中，这位日记作者被军方分派做情报工作，竟然牵连进英王爱德华八世和辛普森夫人的爱情纠葛之中。他对这对情人的观察议论别有韵味。战争留给Mountstuart的是精神上的打击。但是战后他很快就从沉重的心境中解脱出来，寻求快乐的本能使他到了纽约城，成了一个艺术品商人，而后又使他成了一个英语教授，到了非洲和其他地方……他游历了几乎所有的地方,他一生中许多次面临成功，每次却都被突如其来的灾难打断......
45.plotEn: Logan Mountstuart, writer and adventurer, narrates his life, from the Paris of the twenties to the eighties in London, passing through the New York of the fifties.

46.plot: 《吉列足球周六》是英国和爱尔兰天空体育频道在足球赛季期间每周播出的电视节目。该节目每周六下午向观众通报英国和爱尔兰足球协会比赛的最新进展。现任主持人是杰夫·斯特林。该计划由吉列赞助。该节目下午 3 点至 5 点的部分也在天空体育 1 台上播出。
46.plotEn: Gillette Soccer Saturday is a weekly television programme broadcast on Sky Sports in the United Kingdom and Ireland during the football season. The programme updates viewers on the progress of association football games in the United Kingdom and Ireland on Saturday afternoons. The current host is Jeff Stelling. The programme is sponsored by Gillette. The 3pm to 5pm portion of the programme is also shown on Sky Sports 1.

47.plot: 英国政府部门的部长们还没想好政策，舆论主管马尔科姆·塔克已经闯进来改稿、骂人和收拾残局。一句话的措辞，可以毁掉一个上午。
47.plotEn: The ministers of a British government department have not decided the policy yet, and the communications chief Malcolm Tucker has already burst in to rewrite the draft, swear, and clean up the mess. The wording of one sentence can ruin a morning.
47.playbill: 英国政府部门的政治讽刺喜剧，部长们疲于应付媒体和政策灾难。彼得·卡帕尔迪饰演的舆论主管马尔科姆·塔克以花式骂人闻名。主创后来把这套风格带到美国，拍了《副总统》，还拍了电影《灵通人士》。
47.playbillEn: A political satire about a British government department. The ministers are exhausted by the press and by policy disasters. Peter Capaldi’s communications chief, Malcolm Tucker, is famous for the inventiveness of his swearing. The creator later took the style to the United States for Veep, and also made the film In the Loop.

48.plot: 一部震撼人心、感人至深的剧情片，跨越 2003 年伊拉克入侵后的五年。跟随三名士兵和朋友的生活，了解他们处理伊拉克战争和家乡生活的故事。
48.plotEn: A powerful, affecting drama that spans the five years following the invasion of Iraq in 2003. Follow the lives of three soldiers and friends as they deal with the war in Iraq and life back home.

49.plot: 英国Channel4制作爱尔兰背景神职题材经典喜剧，爱尔兰著名喜剧艺人Dermot Morgan主演，Morgan在第3季制作完成后不久即因心脏病英年早逝，此剧也因此过早划上句号。第1，3季均荣获当年BAFTA最佳喜剧剧集奖，同时Morgan并分获当年英国喜剧奖最佳男演 员和BAFTA奖最佳喜剧男演员。
49.plotEn: A crazy comedy about three rather strange parish priests exiled to Craggy Island, a remote island off the Irish west coast.

50.plot: 去大公司面试成功的Jen 以为自己中了头彩，结果却被分配到了地下层的IT部门。部门里只有2个人，Moss 和Roy，2个电脑方面的专家，生活常识类的怪人。对电脑一窍不通的Jen强装出一副精通的样子，惹出了不少笑话。Jen和IT怪人二人组意外的很合拍，总会把一些本来很平常的事情，弄得一发不可收拾，让人哭笑不得。而公司的老板 也会时不时的出现，和他们一起上演让人捧腹大笑的故事。别具一番风味的英式幽默故事在IT部门上演。
50.plotEn: The comedic misadventures of Roy, Moss, and their grifting supervisor Jen, a 'motley crew' of IT support workers at a large corporation headed by a hotheaded yuppie.

51.plot: 彼得-莫法特（Peter Moffat）创作的惊悚片，通过被告人的眼睛看到刑事司法系统的挑战和政治。
51.plotEn: Thriller by Peter Moffat about the challenges and politics of the criminal justice system seen through the eyes of the accused.

52.plot: 《Reverb》是 HBO 每周播出的音乐电视连续剧，重点关注新兴人才，广受好评，已播出四季。 Reverb 通过将观众带上舞台、后台以及美国一些顶级场馆的观众席，捕捉了现场音乐的活力和自发性。与艺术家一起巡演，没有特殊的舞台或二次拍摄，在播出期间，该节目成为收视率最高的定期安排的电视音乐节目。  Reverb 对喜剧演员弗雷德·阿米森 (Fred Armisen) 的职业生涯也起到了至关重要的作用，他曾担任特约记者。喜剧演员兼音乐家戴夫·希尔担任该剧的编剧。他还创作并演唱了该剧的主题曲。
52.plotEn: Reverb, the critically acclaimed weekly HBO music television series spotlighting emerging talent, ran for four seasons. Reverb captured the energy and spontaneity of live music by taking viewers on stage, backstage, and into the audience at some of the premier venues in the United States. Joining artists on tour, without special staging or second takes, During its run, the show became the highest-rated, regularly scheduled music program on television.  Reverb was also critical in the launch of the career of comedian Fred Armisen, who was featured as a special correspondent. Comedian and musician Dave Hill served as a writer on the show. He also composed and performed the show's theme song.

53.plot: 马克和杰里米合住在伦敦南边。镜头钻进他们的眼睛，旁白说出他们真正在想的话：一个是焦虑的贷款经理，一个是不肯找工作的音乐人。
53.plotEn: Mark and Jeremy share a flat in south London. The camera goes in through their eyes, and the narration says what they are actually thinking: one is an anxious loan manager, the other a musician who will not get a job.
53.playbill: 英国情景喜剧，大量第一视角镜头配上两位男主的内心独白，你能同时听到他们说出口的话和心里的真实想法。一个焦虑古板，一个懒散不靠谱，互相嫌弃又离不开。编剧之一杰西·阿姆斯特朗后来创作了《继承之战》。
53.playbillEn: A British sitcom. A lot of it is shot from a first-person view, with the two men’s interior monologue, so you hear what they say and what they actually think. One is anxious and prim. The other is lazy and unreliable. They cannot stand each other and cannot leave. One of the writers, Jesse Armstrong, later created Succession.

54.plot: 9/11 事件后，两个出生在英国的穆斯林兄弟姐妹走向了截然不同的方向。
54.plotEn: Two British-born Muslim siblings are drawn in radically different directions after 9/11.

56.plot: 《罗伊尔家族》是一部英国情景喜剧，由 Caroline Aherne 和 Craig Cash 创作，由格拉纳达电视台为 BBC Two（第 1 系列）和 BBC One（第 2 系列和第 3 系列）制作。它以关注电视的曼彻斯特罗伊尔家族的生活为中心，成员包括懒惰的族长吉姆、勤奋的妻子芭芭拉、他们有资格的女儿丹尼斯、他们的受养子安东尼，以及丹尼斯的未婚夫——后来的丈夫——大卫。
56.plotEn: The Royle Family is a British sitcom created by Caroline Aherne and Craig Cash, and produced by Granada Television for BBC Two (series 1) and BBC One (series 2 and 3). It centres on the lives of a television-fixated Manchester family, the Royles, comprising lazy patriarch Jim, his hard-working wife Barbara, their entitled daughter Denise, their put-upon son Antony, and Denise's lad fiancé–later husband–David.

57.plot: 本片有着令人胆战心惊的剧情，其故事来源于一个臭名昭著的真实罪行，Ian Brady 和 Myra Hindley 两人在60年代中期绑架并杀害了5人，三名儿童和两名青年，其中四人被埋在约克郡的沼泽里。
57.plotEn: See No Evil: The Moors Murders is a British two-part television serial directed by Christopher Menaul. It was produced by Granada Television and broadcast on ITV during May 2006. It tells the story of the Moors Murders, which were committed during the 1960s by Myra Hindley and Ian Brady, from the view of Hindley's sister Maureen Smith and her husband David.

58.plot: 名为“博士”的宇宙最后一个时间领主，有着重生的能力、体力及优越的智力，利用时光机器TARDIS英国传统的蓝色警亭，展开他勇敢的时光冒险之旅，拯救外星生物、地球与时空。
58.plotEn: The Doctor is a Time Lord: a 900 year old alien with 2 hearts, part of a gifted civilization who mastered time travel. The Doctor saves planets for a living—more of a hobby actually, and the Doctor's very, very good at it.

60.plot: 格里高利·豪斯是诊断科的负责人，专接别的医生放弃的病例。他确信病人在撒谎，自己则靠止疼药维持一条受伤的腿和更重的脾气。
60.plotEn: Gregory House runs a department of diagnostics and takes the cases other doctors have given up. He is sure the patient is lying. He himself stays upright on painkillers, for an injured leg and a worse temper.
60.playbill: 天才医生豪斯脾气古怪、嘴毒、对止痛药上瘾，专门诊断别人解决不了的病例，每集都像一个医学版侦探故事。休·劳瑞是英国人，却把美式口音演得毫无破绽。
60.playbillEn: House is a brilliant doctor, rude, mean, and addicted to painkillers. He diagnoses the cases no one else can solve, and each episode is a detective story in a hospital. Hugh Laurie is British, and the American accent has no cracks in it.

61.plot:
靠残疾人补助过活的酒鬼父亲Frank和6个孩子生活在周围到处是酒鬼、乞丐和罪犯的最底层社区，大姐Fiona是家中的头号人物，她、Lip和Ian照看着Carl，Debbie以及还是婴儿的Liam。

跨过宿醉的父亲的身体争抢着偷来的早餐；凌晨4点大开着摇滚乐狂欢；纵容邻居在他们的楼梯上做爱；这个热闹非凡的家庭忙碌、自由、无法无天、充满冒险。他们拥有的不多，但他们懂得生活中最重要的是什么……
61.plotEn: The story of a young group of siblings pretty much abandoned by their parents, surviving by their wits - and humor - on a rough Manchester council estate. Whilst they won't admit it, they need help and find it in Steve, a young middle class lad who falls for Fiona, the oldest sibling, and increasingly finds himself drawn to this unconventional and unique family. Anarchic family life seen through the eyes of an exceptionally bright fifteen year old, who struggles to come of age in the context of his belligerent father, closeted brother, psychotic sister and internet porn star neighbors.

62.plot: 一部英国喜剧电视剧，全剧共三季，主演迪兰·莫兰亦是剧集编剧。三人的故事就这样展开，荒诞、奇异、让人捧腹。这部英国喜剧一共播出三季，在英国、新加坡和澳洲大受欢迎。如果你喜欢《冤家成双对》的英式幽默和《憨豆先生》的荒诞搞怪，那一定不要错过这部情景喜剧《布莱克书店》。
62.plotEn:
Black Books centres around the foul tempered and wildly eccentric bookshop owner Bernard Black. Bernard’s devotion to the twin pleasures of drunkenness and wilful antagonism deepens and enriches both his life and that of Manny, his assistant. Bearded, sweet and good, Manny is everything that Bernard isn’t and is punished by Bernard relentlessly just for the crime of existing. They depend on each other for meaning as Fran, their oldest friend, depends on them for distraction.

Black Books is a haven of books, wine and conversation, the only threat to the group’s peace and prosperity is their own limitless stupidity.

63.plot: 两个波斯尼亚姐妹的痛苦困境以及她们陷入强迫卖淫的黑暗世界。他们的旅程中，一名英国记者努力揭露美国维和人员的阴谋和国际慈善组织的阴谋。
63.plotEn: The wrenching plight of two Bosnian sisters and their descent into the dark world of enforced prostitution. Their journey is intersected by a British journalist struggling to uncover a conspiracy by American peacekeepers and the machinations of an international charity organisation.

64.plot: 《埋葬》是一部英国电视剧，由 World Productions 为 Channel 4 制作，最初于 2003 年放映。该节目由连尼·詹姆斯 (Lennie James) 饰演李·金利 (Lee Kingley)，他为了保护家人免受暴力犯罪分子的侵害而正在服长期徒刑。该节目广受好评，荣获 2004 年英国电视学院奖最佳剧集类奖项。
64.plotEn: Buried is a British television drama series, produced by World Productions for Channel 4 and originally screened in 2003. The programme starred Lennie James as Lee Kingley, who is serving a long prison sentence in order to protect a member of his family from a violent criminal. Critically well-received, the programme won the Best Drama Series category at the British Academy Television Awards in 2004.

65.plot: 斯劳一家纸业公司的区域经理戴维·布伦特接受纪录片拍摄，把管理理解成表演。蒂姆喜欢接待员唐恩，办公室里几乎没有人想被拍到。
65.plotEn: David Brent, the regional manager of a paper company in Slough, agrees to be filmed for a documentary and understands management as a performance. Tim likes the receptionist Dawn. Almost no one in the office wants to be filmed.
65.playbill: 美版的原作，只有两季加两集圣诞特辑，共 14 集。瑞奇·热维斯演的老板大卫·布伦特尴尬到让人想捂脸，伪纪录片喜剧正是从它开始流行起来。比美版更冷、更苦，也更短。
65.playbillEn: The original of the American version. Two seasons plus two Christmas specials, fourteen episodes. Ricky Gervais’s boss, David Brent, is embarrassing enough that you want to cover your face. The mockumentary comedy became popular from this. It is colder, more bitter, and shorter than the American version.

66.plot:
《查理二世：权力与激情》是一部由四部分组成的电视迷你剧，于 2003 年 11 月 16 日至 12 月 7 日在 BBC One 播出。该系列剧描述了查理二世的统治，涵盖了 1660 年他复辟之前的时期。它重点关注他与议会的冲突、他与情妇（尤其是芭芭拉·维利尔斯）的关系，以及他在内战后为恢复英格兰而做出的努力。

当《最后的国王：查理二世国王的权力与激情》在美国上映时，A&E Network 删除了近一个小时的播出时间。剪辑通常很少考虑整个作品的连续性或连贯性。
66.plotEn:
Charles II: The Power & the Passion is a four-part television miniseries, broadcast on BBC One from 16 November to 7 December 2003. The series depicts the reign of Charles II, covering the period just before his Restoration in 1660. It focuses on his conflicts with Parliament, his relationships with his mistresses—particularly Barbara Villiers—and his efforts to restore England after the Civil War.

When shown in the United States, as The Last King: The Power and the Passion of King Charles II, nearly an hour was removed for broadcast by the A&E Network. The edits often make little regard for either the full production's continuity or coherence.

67.plot:
Food Jammers 是一档由 Micah Donovan、Chris Martin 和 Nobu Adilman 主演的烹饪节目；三位后院机械师使用垃圾场零件、发现的物品和当地采购的原料制作自制烹饪设备。烹饪本质上是他们建造东西的借口。

受到对音乐和本土文化的兴趣的启发，Food Jammers 汇聚了众多乐队，例如 Comets on Fire、Snooky Pryor、Stereolab 和 Joel Plaskett。

这三人居住在加拿大安大略省多伦多，他们经常在多伦多当地市场、废品场和路边购物，寻找烹饪所需的东西。

已拍摄三季十三集，外加一小时特别节目。

在美国，它在烹饪频道和卤素电视上播出。
67.plotEn:
Food Jammers is a cooking show featuring Micah Donovan, Chris Martin, and Nobu Adilman; three backyard mechanics who make homebrew cooking equipment using junkyard parts, found objects, and locally sourced ingredients. Cooking is essentially an excuse for them to build things.

Inspired by an interest in music and vernacular culture, Food Jammers features a wide range of bands from the likes of Comets on Fire, Snooky Pryor, Stereolab, and Joel Plaskett.

The trio is based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and they often shop at local Toronto markets, scrap yards, and the curb-side to find things for their cooking.

Three seasons of thirteen episodes have been filmed, plus a one hour special.

In the United States, it airs on Cooking Channel and Halogen TV.

69.plot:
1914-1916年的帝国穿越南极探险队

　　“持久号”(Endurance)于1914年8月1号从伦敦出发。全体船员一共28人。这次探险的目标是徒步横穿南极大陆。事实上，这次又没成功。在行进过程中，浮冰将“持久号”团团围住，使它寸步难行。沙克尔顿和船员不得不弃船搬到浮冰上，在10个月后于1915年11月船沉入海底。此时，沙克尔顿只有一个愿望：把全体船员一个不少的活着带回去。在随后的5个月里，他们28人登上了一块巨大的浮冰，这块浮冰随着时间的推移不断的碎裂，并慢慢的变小了。1916年4月9日，浮冰彻底碎裂了，3艘来自“持久号”的救生船被迅速推到海上。在海上经历了7昼夜的危险之后，他们登上了荒无人烟的大象岛。他们没有坐以待毙，沙克尔顿随后和另外5个人乘上最大的救生艇，横渡大约800英里，来到了南乔治亚岛，这一史诗般的航行在气候极端恶劣的海上持续了16天。
69.plotEn: The true story of Ernest Shackleton's 1914 Endurance expedition to the the South Pole and his epic struggle to lead his crew to safety after his ship was crushed in the pack ice.

70.plot:
30岁的过气女模特叶山南（山口智子饰）在婚礼当天惨遭无良未婚夫卷款逃婚。当她怒不可遏的狂奔到未婚夫居所，只堵截到了无辜的室友濑名秀俊（木村拓哉饰）——一个不得志的24岁钢琴家。身无分文又无家可归的小南对濑名威逼利诱，成为了他的新同居人。两人在同一屋檐下的生活磕磕绊绊 ，事业爱情也都不甚顺畅，渐渐竟生惺惺相惜之感。小南的弟弟叶山真二（竹野内丰饰）带着女友突然造访，与濑名暗恋的学妹奥泽凉子（松隆子饰）暗生情愫，使得众人关系更为微妙。濑名在小南与凉子间徘徊，令追求小南的摄影师杉崎得以强势介入，两人的感情面临岌岌可危的局面……在这个神赐的悠长假期里，他们是否都能听从内心真实的选择，找到最适合的归宿？

本剧曾一举包揽第九回日剧学院赏最优秀作品赏、主演男/女优赏、助演男/女优赏、脚本赏等10项大奖。
70.plotEn: Minami who is dumped by her ex-boyfriend, Asakura, on their wedding day. She later meets Sena, Asakura's ex-roommate and a pianist, and lives with him as she has no other place to stay. What will happen to her during this long vacation?

72.plot:
大唐皇后武则天（归亚蕾 饰）怀胎12月而无法临盆。大雨连天，当大胜突厥的喜讯传来之时，武则天羊水破了。公主就这样在漫天风雨中来到世界。唐高宗李治认定女儿的降世将为天下带来好运，当场赐名太平公主。

　　少年太平（周迅 饰）顽皮不堪，捉弄三个哥哥，戳破好姐妹韦氏（胡静 饰）与哥哥显的小爱情，却也目睹了宫内斗争的风雨。但这些风雨离太平还很遥远。直到她16岁与韦氏偷偷出宫，在夜市扰攘中偶遇薛绍（赵文瑄 饰），少女情窦初开。

　　在太平的请愿下，武则天明知薛绍早有妻室也答应了太平的请婚，一手安排了薛绍妻子慧娘的赐死，也为太平的婚姻悲剧埋下伏笔。婚后无论太平如何温柔体贴，薛绍始终不置一词。然而倔强为爱不顾一切的太平（陈红 饰）赢得了薛家上下的信任，当真相被无情揭露时，薛家对她的唯一请求是保留薛家的血脉——叶儿。薛绍的死给太平带来了极大的创伤，也为母女关系扯开一道无法弥合的裂缝。

　　武则天登基，创立大周朝。太平为了与母亲赌气而嫁给憨厚老实却一无所长的武攸嗣（傅彪 饰），度过了五年漫长的毫无喜悦的婚姻。但这段时期却培养了太平的政治能力，她一而再再而三地为母亲解决了政治危机，深得武则天器重。然而她仍然拒绝入主政治。深爱太平却苦于无法得到太平的心的武攸嗣一次酒后偷欢，被太平撞见后羞愧自尽。太平就这样结束了自己的第二段婚姻。

　　当与薛绍长相酷似的张易之（赵文瑄 饰）出现在太平面前时，太平的心再次被捕。然而在交往中，她明白张易之绝对不是薛绍，他们只有情欲的纠缠，而张易之是渴望通过掌控女人来掌控天下。张易之不仅与太平有染，还与韦氏和武则天有关系，这深深地伤害了太平的心。当张易之企图篡位时，远道赶来的太平一刀结束了他的生命，斩断了自己的爱情。

　　武则天去世，太平成了镇国公主。侄子李隆基对她呵护有加，当年的叶儿也长成了高大的好青年，并与李隆基是挚交好友。这两位年轻人用自己的方式爱着太平：李隆基是要让姑母得到天下权利而爱她，叶儿则是让太平离开权利纷争而爱她。这矛盾一触即发……
72.plotEn: Palace of Desire, also known as Da Ming Gong Ci, is a Chinese television series based on the life story of Princess Taiping, a daughter of China's only female emperor Wu Zetian. Directed by Li Shaohong and Zeng Nianping, the series starred Chen Hong, Zhou Xun, Gui Yalei and Winston Chao in the leading roles. It was first broadcast on CCTV-8 in mainland China on March 30, 2000.

73.plot:
《打卡下班》是一部英国电视剧，于 2000 年至 2003 年在 BBC One 上播出，共四集。由 Red Production Company 制作，保罗·阿博特 (Paul Abbott) 创作。实际上是一个选集节目，讲述了曼彻斯特一家纺织厂一群工人的生活，每一集都聚焦于不同角色的私生活。

您对在您旁边工作的人了解多少？从表面上看，麦金托什纺织公司的生活似乎进展顺利，但在一个隐藏着如此多秘密的社区中，事情远非一帆风顺。在六部强有力的、独立的戏剧中，日常生活因混乱的婚姻、被夺走的激情、失踪的配偶和帮派骚扰而支离破碎。
73.plotEn:
Clocking Off is a British television drama series broadcast on BBC One for four series from 2000 to 2003. It was produced by Red Production Company, and created by Paul Abbott. Effectively an anthology programme that followed the lives of a group of workers at a Manchester textile factory, with each episode focusing on the private life of a different character.

How much do you know about the person working next to you? From the outside, life at Mackintosh Textiles appears to run smoothly, but in a community with so many secrets to hide, things are far from straightforward. In six powerful, self-contained dramas, everyday life is fractured by tumultuous marriages, snatched passions, disappearing spouses, and gang harassment.

75.plot: 约翰·哈里森 (John Harrison) 在 18 世纪的精彩故事，他相信自己可以制造出可以在船上工作的时钟，从而解决海上查找经度的问题。
75.plotEn: The fascinating story of John Harrison who, in the 18th century, believed he could make a clock that would work on board a ship—and so solve the problem of finding longitude at sea.

76.plot: 《警察》以斯坦顿及其周边地区为背景，斯坦顿是一个不露面、严峻的北方飞地，讲述了一群警察与当地社区互动、有时甚至发生冲突的日常工作。
76.plotEn: Set in and around Stanton, a faceless and grim Northern enclave, The Cops depicts the daily grind for a group of policemen and women out on the beat as they interact, and sometimes clash, with the local community.

78.plot: 在目睹前南斯拉夫种族战争的毁灭性后果后，联保部队（联合国保护部队）和平部队的士兵发现不可能回到英国的平民生活。
78.plotEn: After seeing devastating results of ethnic war in former Yugoslavia, soldiers from UNPROFOR (United Nations Protection Force) peace units find it impossible to return to their civil lives in the United Kingdom.

80.plot: 潺潺河流靜靜流過維多利亞時期的倫敦，暗湧的河水攜帶著一個激情的犯罪故事..... 在泰晤士河岸旁，貧窮但能幹的莉西，幫助他的父親從事骯髒的營生。但父女兩發现，下一具屍體將領著他們前往一個原本遙不可及的世界，這是個虛浮，表面的世界，父女倆參加了誇飾，眼界甚高的威佛斯家族所舉辦的餐宴。透過與他們所交錯日趨龐雜的人物，狄更斯寫下了這個愛情與金錢相交織的複雜故事.....
80.plotEn: After his father's will stipulates he must marry Bella Wilfer to inherit his fortune, John Harmon fakes his death to avoid the marriage and the threats on his life. He returns as John Rokesmith and becomes the secretary for the Boffins, who inherit Harmon's estate following his alleged death.

83.plot: 来自世界各地的突发新闻、政治和非凡报道的指挥中心。美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 首席政治主播沃尔夫·布利策 (Wolf Blitzer) 仿照白宫战情室的概念，接待新闻人物和专家，讨论和分析推动当今新闻的故事。
83.plotEn: The command center for breaking news, politics and extraordinary reports from around the world. Patterned after the concept of the White House Situation Room, CNN's lead political anchor Wolf Blitzer hosts newsmakers and experts to discuss and analyze the stories that are driving today's news.

85.plot: 本剧讲述的是一个名叫菲兹的侦探与警察合作破案的故事。这是一部犯罪心理剧，男主角Fitz很特别，他烟酒不离手、体重超重、好赌、狂躁、满嘴脏话，但极其聪明。饰演男主角Fitz的罗彼·考特拉尼，就是“哈利波特”系列中“海格”的扮演者。剧中对犯罪心理的剖析透彻更像是对人性阴暗面的释放、反思和宽恕，破案程序可能不那么写实，但更加精彩。
85.plotEn: The wise-cracking Edward 'Fitz' Fitzgerald is a brilliant but flawed criminal psychologist with a remarkable insight into the criminal mind.

86.plot:
《政治家的妻子》是一部由宝拉·米尔恩 (Paula Milne) 编剧的英国电视政治剧，于 1995 年在第四频道播出，由特雷弗·伊芙 (Trevor Eve) 和朱丽叶·史蒂文森 (Juliet Stevenson) 主演。

故事围绕英国政府家庭大臣、雄心勃勃的政治家邓肯·马特洛克展开，他因被发现与一名前护送者、后来成为议会研究员的人有染而卷入小报丑闻。邓肯的妻子弗洛拉（Flora）对此事的反应逐渐成为媒体关注的焦点。最初，她扮演忠诚妻子的角色，但作为丈夫的助手，她向她提供了有关这件事和其他可能发生的各种政治丑闻的细节。她开始通过向媒体和英国保守党的坚定支持者泄密和错误信息来破坏丈夫的正直和声誉。在媒体上发生了一系列越来越耸人听闻和具有破坏性的故事后，她的丈夫被迫羞辱地辞职。最后一集以电视上宣布的补选结果结束。弗洛拉·马特洛克在她所在政党的支持下获胜，而她的丈夫则被流放到比利时担任一个小职务。
86.plotEn:
The Politician's Wife is a British television political drama written by Paula Milne, broadcast on Channel 4 in 1995 and starring Trevor Eve and Juliet Stevenson.

The story centres around high-flying politician Duncan Matlock, Families Minister for the UK Government, who becomes embroiled in tabloid scandal as it is discovered that he has been having an affair with a former escort turned parliamentary researcher. Duncan's wife Flora becomes the focus of media attention as her reactions to the revelations are played out. Initially she plays out the part of the loyal wife, but as an aide of her husband feeds her details about the affair and various other political scandals that could be made to happen. She begins to sabotage her husband's integrity and reputation through a campaign of leaks and misinformation to the press and British Conservative Party stalwarts. After a series of increasingly sensational and damaging stories in the press, her husband is forced to resign in humiliation. The last episode closes with the results of the by-election being announced on TV. Flora Matlock wins with the support of her party whilst her husband is exiled to a minor post in Belgium.

88.plot: 一名推销员开始在一家设施内运营一家医院广播电台，为有精神健康需求的人服务。
88.plotEn: A salesman starts to run a hospital radio station inside a facility for people with mental heath needs.

89.plot: 侦探警司托尼·克拉克是投诉调查局的一位雄心勃勃的成员，投诉调查局是一个内部组织，负责调查英格兰和威尔士警察内部的腐败指控。一路走来，克拉克克服了上级的强大影响和私人生活中的问题，最引人注目的是他与 WPC 珍妮·迪恩有染后婚姻的破裂。
89.plotEn: Detective Superintendent Tony Clark is an ambitious member of the Complaints Investigation Bureau, an internal organisation that investigates claims of corruption inside the police in England and Wales. Along the way Clark overcomes strong influence from his superiors and problems in his private life, most notably the break-up of his marriage following an affair with WPC Jenny Dean.

90.plot: 《最后的夏日美酒》的情景喜剧前传以 1939 年约克郡的一个小村庄为背景，当时英国已做好战争准备。
90.plotEn: Sitcom prequel to Last of the Summer Wine set in a small Yorkshire village in 1939 as Britain becomes poised for war.

91.plot: 《摩斯警长》是一部由约翰·肖、凯文·惠特利主演，丹尼尔·波义尔编剧，大卫·拉塞尔斯制片，安德里安·舍尔可德导演的英国电视剧。
91.plotEn: Inspector Morse is a detective drama based on Colin Dexter's series of Chief Inspector Morse novels. The series starred John Thaw as Chief Inspector Morse and Kevin Whately as Sergeant Lewis, as well as a large cast of notable actors and actresses.

92.plot: 年迈的历史学家杰拉德·米德尔顿沉默寡言，做事有条不紊，是一个习惯性的人，喜欢不被打扰的日常生活。与妻子分居，也不赞成小儿子的工作，米德尔顿的生活和事业开始失去意义。米德尔顿敏锐地意识到自己的错误和自己在自己周围造成的空虚，随着他的过去追上了他，他被迫再次重返社会。
92.plotEn: Aging historian Gerald Middleton is taciturn and methodical, a creature of habit who prefers his daily routine undisturbed. Separated from his wife and disapproving of his youngest son’s job, Middleton's life and career are beginning to lose meaning. Keenly aware of his faults and the void he's created around himself, Middleton is forced back into society once more as his past catches up with him.

95.plot:
故事发生在位于英国的一座地处偏远的小镇里，女孩珍妮特（夏洛特·科曼 Charlotte Coleman 饰）出生成长在一个信奉新教的家庭之中。珍妮特的母亲（杰拉尔丁·麦克伊万 Geraldine McEwan 饰）是一位非常虔诚而又极端的教徒，在她的眼中，世界上只有两种人，一种是和她信仰同一种宗教的战友，剩下的则都是敌人。

　　在偏执的母亲的影响下，珍妮特慢慢学会了压抑内心里真实的声音，实际上，珍妮特是一名同性恋者，但这个秘密是绝对不能够被其他人知道的。要命的是，一个正中珍妮特红心的女孩出现在了她的生活里，这个女孩的存在让珍妮特再也无法忍受心惊胆战躲躲藏藏的日子了，她和母亲之间最激烈的战争爆发了。
95.plotEn: Seven-year-old Jess is removed from her peculiar Pentecostal home and sent to school.

96.plot: 抗战初期，外国留学生方鸿渐（陈道明饰）回到了祖国。方鸿渐其实是在国外混了几年，一个学位没取得，最后没法才买了个学位归国的。出身封建家庭的鸿渐家里早给他订了亲，只是未婚妻没来得及和他结婚就逝世了。鸿渐回国后一直居住在丈人的家里，丈人颇有些能耐，为他谋了一份不错的职业。女博士苏文纨一直对鸿渐有好感，而鸿渐迷恋的却是在苏小姐家里第一次拜访认识的唐小姐。随后，鸿渐与唐小姐渐渐打得火热，然而丈人家看出了他和唐小姐的往来，渐渐冷落了他，而后鸿渐和唐小姐亦因误会而结束。 失恋后的鸿渐和当时同样追求苏小姐失败的留学生赵辛楣（英达饰）成了莫逆，二人同时受到了内地的三闾大学的聘请。于是两位好友一起上路了，前往三闾大学去开展他们的新生活。
96.plotEn: Set in the 1930s, “Fortress Besieged” follows the misadventures of Fang Hung-chien, a bumbling everyman who wastes his time studying abroad, and secures a fake degree when learning he has run out of money and must return home to China. Fang was the son of a country gentleman. A marriage had been arranged for him while at university, but the intended wife died before he could see her.

97.plot: 工人阶级、左倾哈里·帕金斯当选总理。当他致力于通过民主进程实施社会变革时，保守派及其盟友悄悄开始努力推翻他。帕金斯的目标包括核裁军、解散报纸垄断、开放政府以及关闭英国领土上的所有美国军事基地。尽管许多政府成员反对他，但他得到了内政大臣琼·库克及其主要幕僚的支持。
97.plotEn: Working-class, left-leaning Harry Perkins is elected PM. As he works to implement social change via democratic process, the conservatives and their allies quietly begin working to remove him. Perkins' goals include nuclear disarmament, the dissolution of newspaper monopolies, open government and the closure of all US military bases on UK soil. While many members of the govnerment oppose him, he finds some support in Home Secretary Joan Cook and key members of his staff.

98.plot: 当一位英俊的红发女郎加入乐队巡演时，苏格兰的“摇滚之王”Majestics 遇到了麻烦。
98.plotEn: Trouble ensues for the Majestics, Scotland's "Kings of Rock", when a good-looking redhead joins the band on tour.

99.plot: 露丝·帕切特拥有一切：一个巨大的、长满疣的身体、一个标准的郊区住宅、几个不守规矩的孩子、一只狗、一只猫和一只豚鼠。她还有不忠的会计师丈夫博博，他对她的存在感到不满。波波想要并且被浪漫小说家玛丽·费舍尔想要，她住在海边的灯塔里。当波波为了玛丽而离开露丝时，露丝认为玛丽根本不知道关于爱的第一件事，而她要教她。
99.plotEn: Ruth Patchett has it all: a large, warty body, a standard suburban home, a couple of unruly children, a dog, a cat and a guinea pig. She also has Bobbo, her unfaithful accountant husband who resents her very existence. Bobbo wants, and is wanted by, romance novelist Mary Fisher, who lives in a lighthouse by the sea. When Bobo leaves Ruth for Mary, Ruth decides that Mary doesn't know the first thing about love, and she's gonna teach her.

100.plot: 环保活动人士艾玛·克雷文在她父亲、当地警察督察罗纳德·克雷文面前被谋杀。通过对这起死亡事件的调查，他揭露了 20 世纪 80 年代英国核政策的阴暗面，令人难以忘怀。
100.plotEn: Environmental activist Emma Craven is murdered in front of her father, local police inspector Ronald Craven. Investigating the death leads him through a haunting revelation of the murkiness of British nuclear policy of the 1980s.

101.plot: 在第二次世界大战中英国统治的最后几年，印度因强奸而被不公正逮捕，引发了在战争和个人阴谋背景下探讨身份和个人责任的问题。
101.plotEn: In India, during the final years of British rule in World War II, an unjust arrest for rape sets off questions of identity and personal responsibility being explored against a background of war and personal intrigue.

102.plot:
《肯尼迪》是一部时长五小时的迷你剧，由雷格·加德尼编剧，吉姆·戈达德执导。该迷你剧由中央独立电视台制作，最初于 1983 年 11 月 20 日肯尼迪遇刺 20 周年前后在美国播出。这部电视迷你剧讲述了约翰·F·肯尼迪 (John F. Kennedy) 1961 年至 1963 年总统任期的传记。

这部迷你剧由马丁·辛 (Martin Sheen) 饰演约翰·肯尼迪 (John F. Kennedy) 总统，约翰·谢伊 (John Shea) 饰演罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 (Robert F. Kennedy)，布莱尔·布朗 (Blair Brown) 饰演杰奎琳·肯尼迪 (Jacqueline Kennedy)，E.G.马歇尔饰演约瑟夫·P·肯尼迪，文森特·加迪尼亚饰演约翰·埃德加·胡佛，凯尔西·格兰默饰演斯蒂芬·史密斯等。

该剧在 NBC 播出，并销往 50 个国家，其中 27 个国家同时播出。该剧获得 3 项金球奖和 4 项英国电影和电视艺术学院奖提名，并获得英国电影和电视艺术学院奖最佳剧集奖和最佳化妆奖。
102.plotEn:
Kennedy is a five-hour miniseries written by Reg Gadney and directed by Jim Goddard. The miniseries was produced by Central Independent Television and originally aired in the United States starting on 20 November 1983 around the time of the 20th anniversary of the Kennedy assassination. The TV miniseries was a biography of the 1961-1963 presidency of John F. Kennedy.

The mini-series stars Martin Sheen as President John F. Kennedy, John Shea as Robert F. Kennedy, Blair Brown as Jacqueline Kennedy, E.G. Marshall as Joseph P. Kennedy, Vincent Gardenia as J. Edgar Hoover and Kelsey Grammer as Stephen Smith amongst many others.

The series was broadcast on NBC, and was also sold to 50 Countries, with 27 of them broadcasting the series simultaneous. The series was nominated for 3 Golden Globes and 4 BAFTA, and won Baftas for Best Drama Series and Best Make Up.

103.plot: 因妻子外遇而离婚的黑板五郎，带着一对儿女从东京来到充满田园风光的北海道富良野生活。影片细腻地描写他们在北方富良野的田园生活和爱情，以及从学校走入社会工作，成家立业，生儿育女。剧中人物尽管有各种不如意的生活经历和自己无法掌控的现实，但他们最终都能战胜所面临的逆境，更加理解身边的人和事。
103.plotEn: Narrated by the son, Jun, the tale follows the lives of two children torn between their parents and their parents' divorce. Jun, and his sister Hotaru, grow and mature - willingly and sometimes forcibly - in the harsh climates of Hokkaido, learning the ways of life through their interaction with the folk of Furano.

106.plot: 改编自维拉·布里顿 (Vera Brittain) 1933 年的自传《青春之约》(Testament of Youth) 的戏剧化作品，纪念遭受第一次世界大战摧残的一代人，记录了她在伦敦、马耳他以及法国前线担任护士的经历。故事以 18 岁的维拉（Vera）开始，她是一位造纸厂老板的优雅女儿，她怀着“逃离乡下年轻淑女的希望”。她的计划是去牛津大学。
106.plotEn: A dramatization of Vera Brittain's 1933 autobiography Testament of Youth—a memorial to a generation devastated by WWI—chronicles her experiences as a nurse in London and Malta and at the front lines in France. It opens with 18-year-old Vera, the genteel daughter of a paper-mill owner, nurturing "hopes of escaping from provincial young ladyhood." Her plan is to attend Oxford.

107.plot: Fawlty Towers由John Cleese和他当时的妻子Connie Booth共同创意并编剧，并且均出演主要角色。该剧集以Torquay一家小旅馆Fawlty Towers为背景，主要人物包括John Cleese饰演的旅馆主人，笨手笨脚、脾气糟糕、极度老派、市侩而且怕老婆到死的Basil Fawlty；爱唠叨、笑声可怕、能让比自己高一个半头的老公噤若寒蝉的旅馆女主人Sybil Fawlty；Connie Booth饰演的经常被搅进老板倒霉事的临时女侍Polly；以及Basil为了省钱而雇佣的、听不懂几句英文、经常遭老板拳脚相向的西班牙侍者兼小厮Manuel。由这四位经营的Fawlty Towers可想而知是经常陷入窘境难以自拔了，而旅馆的几位长住客人和各色过往人等则常常成为其中的牺牲品。
107.plotEn: Owner Basil Fawlty, his wife Sybil, a chambermaid Polly, and Spanish waiter Manuel attempt to run their hotel amidst farcical situations and an array of demanding guests.

108.plot: 当仍是威尔士亲王时，未来的爱德华八世遇到了已婚的美国社交名流沃利斯·辛普森。他们的关系在宫殿和议会中引起了轩然大波，尤其是当乔治五世国王去世、辛普森夫人离婚、爱德华国王宣布打算娶她时。
108.plotEn: While still the Prince of Wales, the future Edward VIII meets the married American socialite, Wallis Simpson. Their relationship causes furor in the palace and in parliament, especially when King George V dies, Mrs. Simpson gets divorced, and King Edward announces his intention to marry her.

109.plot:
《Going Straight》是 BBC 的一部情景喜剧，是《Porridge》的直接衍生剧，由罗尼·巴克 (Ronnie Barker) 饰演诺曼·斯坦利·弗莱彻 (Norman Stanley Fletcher)，该喜剧刚刚从虚构的斯莱德监狱中上映，该监狱是早期剧集的背景地。

弗莱彻试图成为社会的诚实成员，并发誓在获释后远离犯罪。标题指的是他的尝试，“直”是一个俚语，意思是诚实，与“弯曲”相反，即不诚实。

同样重新出现的还有理查德·贝金赛尔饰演的伦尼·戈德伯，他是弗莱彻天真的年轻狱友，现在正在与他的女儿英格丽德交往。她的弟弟雷蒙德由十几岁的尼古拉斯·林德赫斯特扮演。

1978 年只制作了六集连续剧。它吸引了超过 1500 万观众，并于 1979 年 3 月获得了英国电影和电视艺术学院奖，但由于贝金赛尔在同月早些时候过早去世，制作更多连续剧的希望已经破灭。
109.plotEn:
Going Straight is a BBC sitcom which was a direct spin-off from Porridge, starring Ronnie Barker as Norman Stanley Fletcher, newly released from the fictional Slade Prison where the earlier series had been set.

It sees Fletcher trying to become an honest member of society, having vowed to stay away from crime on his release. The title refers to his attempt, 'straight' being a slang term meaning being honest, in contrast to 'bent', i.e., dishonest.

Also re-appearing was Richard Beckinsale as Lennie Godber, who was Fletcher's naïve young cellmate and was now in a relationship with his daughter Ingrid. Her brother Raymond was played by a teenage Nicholas Lyndhurst.

Only one series, of six episodes, was made in 1978. It attracted an audience of over 15 million viewers and won a BAFTA award in March 1979, but hopes of a further series had already been dashed by Beckinsale's premature death earlier in the same month.

110.plot: 由简·拉波泰尔 (Jane Lapotaire) 主演的 BBC 迷你剧。该节目记录了科学先驱玛丽·居里的工作，她进行了放射性研究，发现了著名的镭，并获得了诺贝尔物理奖和化学奖。该节目还关注影响这位即将成为著名革命家的关键事件，包括她丈夫（奈杰尔·霍桑饰）的毁灭性死亡以及她随后的争议性事件。
110.plotEn: BBC mini-series with Jane Lapotaire in the title role. The programme chronicles the work of scientific pioneer Marie Curie as she conducts her research into radioactivity, makes the famous discovery of Radium and wins Nobel Prizes for both Physics and Chemistry. The programme also looks at key events that affected the soon-to-be famous revolutionary including the devastating death of her husband (Nigel Hawthorne) and her subsequent controversial affairs.

111.plot: 懦弱的房东里格斯比坐在一间破旧的床上，他的自负被长期受苦受难的房客揭穿。
111.plotEn: Set in a seedy bedsit, the cowardly landlord Rigsby has his conceits debunked by his long suffering tenants.

112.plot:
《Rock Follies》及其续集《Rock Follies of '77》是 20 世纪 70 年代在英国电视上播出的一部音乐剧。故事情节分为两季，共 12 集，讲述了一个名为“小女士”的虚构女性摇滚乐队为获得认可和成功而奋斗的跌宕起伏。该剧由鲁拉·兰斯卡 (Rula Lenska)、夏洛特·康威尔 (Charlotte Cornwell) 和朱莉·卡温顿 (Julie Covington) 饰演小女士们，并得到埃姆林·普莱斯 (Emlyn Price)、贝丝·波特 (Beth Porter)、苏·琼斯-戴维斯 (Sue Jones-Davies)、史蒂芬·摩尔 (Stephen Moore) 和小内尔 (Little Nell) 等人的支持。该剧是泰晤士电视台以非常低的预算制作的，其风格灵感来自边缘戏剧。

该系列取得了成功，赢得了三项英国电影和电视艺术学院奖，原声带专辑在英国排行榜上排名第一。
112.plotEn:
Rock Follies, and its sequel, Rock Follies of '77, was a musical drama shown on British television in the 1970s. The storyline, over 12 episodes and two series, followed the ups and downs of a fictional female rock band called the "Little Ladies" as they struggled for recognition and success. The series starred Rula Lenska, Charlotte Cornwell and Julie Covington as the Little Ladies, with support from Emlyn Price, Beth Porter, Sue Jones-Davies, Stephen Moore and Little Nell among others. The series was made with a very low budget for Thames Television, with a style inspired by fringe theatre.

The series was a success, winning three BAFTA Awards and the soundtrack album reaching No.1 in the UK Charts.

113.plot:
《粥》是一部英国情景喜剧，于 1974 年至 1977 年在 BBC1 播出，连播三集、两部圣诞特别节目和一部也名为《粥》的故事片。该片由迪克·克莱门特和伊恩·拉·弗雷纳斯编剧，由罗尼·巴克和理查德·贝金赛尔主演，饰演坎伯兰虚构的 HMP 斯莱德监狱中的两名囚犯。 “做粥”是英国俚语，意为服刑期间，粥曾经是英国监狱的传统早餐。

该系列之后于 1978 年推出了续集《Going Straight》，该片确立了弗莱彻不会再次回到监狱。 《粥》在 2004 年 BBC 评选的 100 部最伟大英国情景喜剧中排名第七。
113.plotEn:
Porridge is a British situation comedy broadcast on BBC1 from 1974 to 1977, running for three series, two Christmas specials and a feature film also titled Porridge. Written by Dick Clement and Ian La Frenais, it stars Ronnie Barker and Richard Beckinsale as two inmates at the fictional HMP Slade in Cumberland. "Doing porridge" is British slang for serving a prison sentence, porridge once being the traditional breakfast in UK prisons.

The series was followed by a 1978 sequel, Going Straight, which established that Fletcher would not be going back to prison again. Porridge was voted number seven in a 2004 BBC poll of the 100 greatest British sitcoms.

114.plot: 《爱德华七世》是 ATV 制作的 1975 年电视剧迷你剧。该系列改编自菲利普·马格努斯所著的爱德华七世传记，描绘了大量历史人物，包括但不限于萨克森-科堡和哥达的阿尔伯特亲王、阿瑟·贝尔福、阿瑟·韦尔斯利、第一代威灵顿公爵、爱德华七世、乔治五世、拿破仑三世、俄罗斯尼古拉二世、维多利亚女王、威廉一世、威廉二世、温斯顿·丘吉尔、亨利·约翰·坦普尔和奥托·冯俾斯麦。
114.plotEn: Edward the Seventh is a 1975 television drama miniseries produced by ATV. Based on the biography of Edward VII by Philip Magnus, the series features depictions of a vast number of historical figures including, but not limited to, Prince Albert of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha, Arthur Balfour, Arthur Wellesley, 1st Duke of Wellington, Edward VII, George V, Napoleon III, Nicholas II of Russia, Queen Victoria, Wilhelm I, Wilhelm II, Winston Churchill, Henry John Temple, and Otto von Bismarck.

116.plot: 校长莎拉·伯顿是一位左翼女权主义者，她对学生所面临的社会不公正感到厌恶。尽管她有信仰，她还是不情愿地发现自己爱上了一位保守党地主，而他的妻子患有精神错乱。
116.plotEn: Headmistress Sarah Burton, a left-wing feminist, is disgusted by the social injustices faced by her pupils. In spite of her beliefs, she reluctantly finds herself falling in love with a Tory landowner whose wife is suffering from insanity.

118.plot: 楼上：富有的贵族贝拉米家族。楼下：他们忠诚而活泼的仆人。近 30 年来，他们在伦敦豪华贝尔格莱维亚区伊顿广场 165 号共同居住了一栋时尚联排别墅，经历了社会变革、政治动荡、丑闻和第一次世界大战的恐怖。
118.plotEn: Upstairs: the wealthy, aristocratic Bellamys. Downstairs: their loyal and lively servants. For nearly 30 years, they share a fashionable townhouse at 165 Eaton Place in London’s posh Belgravia neighborhood, surviving social change, political upheaval, scandals, and the horrors of the First World War.

119.plot:
那些可能的小伙子发生了什么？是一部英国情景喜剧，于1973年1月9日至1974年4月9日在BBC1播出。这是 20 世纪 60 年代中期热门影片《The Likely Lads》的彩色续集。与其前身一样，它是由迪克·克莱门特 (Dick Clement) 和伊恩·拉·弗雷纳斯 (Ian La Frenais) 创建和编写的。两个系列共 26 集电视剧；随后的 45 分钟圣诞特别节目于 1974 年 12 月 24 日播出。

1975 年，演员们在 BBC 电台改编的系列 1 中重聚，并于当年 7 月至 10 月在 Radio 4 上播出。 1976年，拍摄了一部故事片衍生片。然而，在该书发布前后，罗德尼·比维斯和詹姆斯·博拉姆因涉及媒体的误会而闹翻，此后就没有再说过话。 2005年，贝威斯在宣传他的自传时，终于证实了这一一直被怀疑的情况。与贝威斯不同的是，博拉姆一直不愿谈论这部剧，并否决了任何复兴他的角色的尝试。
119.plotEn:
Whatever Happened to the Likely Lads? is a British sitcom which was broadcast between 9 January 1973 and 9 April 1974 on BBC1. It was the colour sequel to the mid-1960s hit The Likely Lads. It was created and written, as was its predecessor, by Dick Clement and Ian La Frenais. There were 26 television episodes over two series; and a subsequent 45-minute Christmas special was aired on 24 December 1974.

The cast were reunited in 1975 for a BBC radio adaptation of series 1, transmitted on Radio 4 from July to October that year. In 1976, a feature film spin-off was made. Around the time of its release, however, Rodney Bewes and James Bolam fell out over a misunderstanding involving the press and have not spoken since. This long-suspected situation was finally confirmed by Bewes while promoting his autobiography in 2005. Unlike Bewes, Bolam is consistently reluctant to talk about the show, and has vetoed any attempt to revive his character.

120.plot: 改编自 A.E Coppard 和 H.E. 的戏剧和短篇小说的选集系列。贝茨描绘了 20 世纪初的英国乡村生活和乡村浪漫。它呈现了关于人际关系和原始情感的不感伤的故事——发自内心的激情、严重的挫败感、不言而喻的爱和破坏性的嫉妒。
120.plotEn: An anthology series adapted from plays and short stories by A.E Coppard and H.E. Bates, depicting English country life and rural romance at the turn of the 20th-century. It presents unsentimental stories of human relationships and raw emotions – heartfelt passions, crippling frustrations, unspoken love and destructive jealousy.

121.plot:
《我的邻家妻子》是一部由布莱恩·克莱门斯 (Brian Clemens) 创作的 BBC 情景喜剧，由理查德·韦林 (Richard Waring) 编剧，于 1972 年首播。该剧共 13 集，主要讲述一对夫妇乔治·巴塞特 (George Basset) 和苏西·巴塞特 (Suzie Basset) 的故事。离婚后，每个人都试图重新开始。他们搬到乡下，却发现自己搬进了毗邻的小屋。

该剧于 1979 年重播时，获得了比首播更好的收视率，并在重播期间多次位居 BBC1 每周收视率榜首。部分原因是英国独立电视台罢工，导致英国观众在数周内只能观看 BBC1 和 BBC2。
121.plotEn:
My Wife Next Door is a BBC sitcom created by Brian Clemens which was written by Richard Waring and was first broadcast in 1972. It ran for 13 episodes and focused on a couple, George Basset and Suzie Basset. Each tries to start afresh after their divorce. They move to the country, only to find that they have moved into adjoining cottages.

When the series was repeated in 1979, it gained better ratings than its first outing and topped the BBC1 weekly ratings several times during the repeat run. This was in part due to the ITV strike that limited British viewing to BBC1 and BBC2 for several weeks.
